20.name: Old Friends, New Era
20.overview: Vicki returns only to find herself in the middle of Shannon and Tamra, who are at odds after an explosive encounter. Recently engaged and in pre-martial bliss, Gina ponders questions about her new relationship status, while Emily’s home life is in a rebuilding phase. Heather gets a shakeup when her mother moves to California from New York. Jennifer brings new friend Carmella to Heather’s Hearts & Heels party, where Jennifer reveals information that threatens Heather’s friendship with Tamra.

20.name: Not On My Bingo Card
20.overview: Gina throws Emily a drag bingo-themed 50th birthday party where the ladies lean into the wisdom of their age. Shannon befriends Carmella, but Vicki has questions about Carmella’s past. Heather and Jennifer butt heads over transparency in their friendships with Tamra. Emily confronts Tamra about their work relationship, causing egos to clash.

20.name: Why Can't We Be Friends?
20.overview: Vicki finds herself playing referee in an attempt to rekindle the Tres Amigas friendship.

20.name: Boxed In
20.overview: Word spreads fast in the OC about Carmella's extravagant birthday gift to Emily as Gina speculates about the motive behind it; Tamra wonders why she's left out of Heather's TikToks as Jenn tries to work out the dynamic of their friendship; a party game opens Pandora's box and leaves many questioning where they stand with one another.

20.name: Designers and Dildos
20.overview: Friendships are fraught in Orange County as loyalties are questioned between Heather, Emily and Gina; Tamra talks to Sophia about marriage; Shannon looks to her father for life advice; Carmella opens up about her past while Gina and Vicki question her motives around gifts and job opportunities; in an effort to rid herself of her Debbie Downer title, Vicki brings the women to a winery.

20.name: Suite & Sour
20.overview: The women of Orange County head to Las Vegas where they play “Showgirl” for a day and showdown at night. Carmella attempts to work through a relationship betrayal. Emily tries to stabilize rocky marriage ground. At dinner overlooking the Vegas strip, Heather is confronted with multiple complaints about her need for control.

20.name: All Bets Are Off
20.overview: The Vegas vacation continues as the ladies head to the Grand Canyon. Jenn tries to redirect Shannon's frustrations, resulting in an admission in Shannon and Heather's friendship.

20.name: Sangria, Songria
20.overview: Carmella throws a pool party at her Rancho Santa Fe house where she introduces the ladies to her kids and boyfriend. Emily and Shane celebrate their anniversary. Heather uses Carmella’s real estate expertise. Shannon gets financial advice from Vicki. The ladies discuss Heather’s recent behavior, sparking a conversation about her intention within the group.

20.name: Ring Of Truth
20.overview: Gina begins to question her friendship with Heather after learning that Carmella is helping Heather find an apartment. Emily questions Heather over her true feelings about Carmella. Tamra and Shannon’s rekindling comes to a halt when Shannon puts up a boundary that causes Tamra to bail on their lunch. Jennifer gathers the group for some much-needed energy healing, only for Vicki to find her relationship in the ring of fire.

20.name: Forbidden Fruit
20.overview: The ladies split up for dual trips to Los Olivos and La Quinta. Emily, Jenn and Shannon question their host Vicki, who prioritizes work over her guests. Gina confronts Heather about doing real estate business with Carmella while talking behind her back. After being pressed about her relationship, Vicki reaches a boiling point, leaving Jenn and Emily decide whether to stay or abandon ship.

20.name: A Tale of Two Trips
20.overview: As the two group trips come to a close, Jenn and Emily make a bold statement that leaves Vicki taken back. Back in the OC, Heather gives her mother a look at her new apartment while Travis surprises Gina. Tensions flare between Emily and Shane. Carmella questions her future with Danny. When Tamra presses Vicki about her behavior in La Quinta, Vicki opens up about her insecurities.

20.name: Lei It On Me
20.overview: Tamra celebrates her granddaughter’s birthday at a rare family gathering. Heather and Emily work out their issues, but Heather continues to question their friendship. Shannon hosts a luau where Emily and Jenn push back at Vicki for her outburst in La Quinta. The ladies see a new side of Carmella when she becomes the target of Vicki’s comments.

20.name: Don't Look Now
20.overview: Emily invites the ladies for a Persian Party. Vicki takes issue with Tamra for revealing sensitive information. Heather and Terry have a heartfelt talk about their family. Carmella and Jenn tour a house.

20.name: Friends And Fortunes
20.overview: Heather and Alexis hash out their unfinished business at Tamra’s Vena party before the ladies travel to Tokyo. Shannon struggles with Archie’s health decline. Carmella's medical issues change the course of the trip. Tamra and Jenn get closer as roommates. Emily shares that things are falling apart at home with Shane. Gina brings everyone to a temple where the ladies learn their fortunes, both good and bad.

20.name: For Goodness Sake
20.overview: The ladies take in all the Tokyo sites as Tamra processes her fortune about her daughter. Jenn and Emily encourage Tamra to talk to Vicki about comments made years ago. When Tamra’s emotions reach their peak, Shannon is there to help, bringing them closer. Heather and Gina question Shannon and Vicki’s friendship. They all gather for a sushi-making class where things get messy as they navigate being in the middle of Tamra and Vicki’s historical friendship problems.

20.name: Mad Money
20.overview: On their final day in Tokyo, the ladies splurge on vintage designer goods and tensions flare as the group questions Gina’s finances. Back in the OC, Carmella opens up about big life changes and decisions. Jenn starts a new business in the fitness space. Tamra makes an admission to Vick. Emily and Gina doubt the reality of Tamra’s intentions with her friendships.

20.name: Reach For The Skytops
20.overview: Coming off a friendship high from Tokyo, Jenn wonders if her rekindled friendship with Tamra is genuine. Heather comes to accept her relationship with her mother. Shannon finds a suitor at a dive bar. Vicki hosts a 20-year anniversary party attended by friends new and old, celebrating what brought them all together in the place where it all started.

20.name: Reunion, Part 1
20.overview: The reunion kicks off as questions surrounding Vicki’s relationship take center stage. Jenn makes a shocking allegation. Carmella opens up about her breakup and pushes back at Vicki’s assertions about her parenting. Shannon and Tamra’s friendship rollercoaster continues. Emily and Gina call out Heather over her off-screen behavior toward Carmella.

20.name: Reunion, Part 2
20.overview: The reunion concludes as Emily and Gina’s friendships with Heather reach their breaking point. Emily shares an update on Luke’s diagnosis. Jenn confronts Vicki over her lack of accountability, while Shannon takes a step back from defending her. Tamra and Jenn defend their rekindled friendship. The ladies end the night by celebrating 20 years of housewives.

originalTitle: The Real Housewives of Orange County
overview: A view into the lives of several women and their families who live in one of the wealthiest communities in the country with the viewer taken "inside the gates" to show their lives aren't always perfect.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The gates of Coto de Caza open to five wealthy women juggling demanding careers, complex families, and extreme social pressure to maintain their youth and status. Vicki Gunvalson runs her insurance agency while employing struggling single mother Lauri Waring, and powerhouse realtor Jeana Keough manages three competitive teens alongside an emotionally distant husband. Meanwhile, young Jo De La Rosa resists her fiancé's traditional domestic expectations, and Kimberly Bryant faces a major health scare that alters her future in the OC.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Tammy Knickerbocker joins the group to rebuild her life after losing her fortune, stepping in for a departing Kimberly Bryant. Social friction sparks when Jo De La Rosa learns her on-and-off fiancé Slade briefly dated Lauri Waring, though Lauri is quickly distracted by a fairytale romance with a wealthy businessman. At the same time, veteran mothers Vicki Gunvalson and Jeana Keough face mounting hurdles at home, dealing with unmotivated children and career-stalling sports injuries under their roofs.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As the women expand their social circle with group trips, a disastrous real estate partnership shatters Vicki Gunvalson and Jeana Keough’s longtime friendship. Fiery newcomer Tamra Barney joins the fold, bringing fun energy to the group while privately battling intense tension between her controlling husband and rebellious adult son. Amidst these shifting dynamics, Jeana files for separation, Lauri Waring plans an extravagant winter wedding, and tragedy strikes Tammy Knickerbocker’s family when her ex-husband suddenly passes away.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The mid-2000s housing crash brings severe financial strain to the community, forcing women like Jeana Keough to navigate a brutal economic downturn. Young newcomer Gretchen Rossi sparks immediate gossip and skepticism from Tamra Barney and Vicki Gunvalson due to her engagement to an ailing, wealthy older man. This mutual distrust culminates in a disastrous, alcohol-fueled etiquette dinner, all while Vicki’s marriage crumbles and Lauri Peterson steps away from the group to focus on her troubled son.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: As financial hardship hits the neighborhood, longtime resident Jeana Keough steps back from the toxic group dynamic, making room for devout Christian mother Alexis Bellino. Tensions mount across the community as Gretchen Rossi begins a polarizing romance with Slade Smiley, and Lynne Curtin’s opulent lifestyle secretly unravels due to her husband's hidden debts. Meanwhile, the tight bond between Vicki Gunvalson and Tamra Barney completely ruptures when Vicki's vocal disapproval of Tamra's husband forces Tamra to choose between her spouse and her best friend.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: As the women attempt to move past old traumas, deeply rooted conflicts resurface when Alexis Bellino introduces her friend Peggy Tanous, sparking an intense, unspoken rivalry between the two wealthy mothers. Tamra Barney navigates a volatile divorce while finding solace in a steamy new romance with Eddie Judge and drawing community whispers over her close friendship with a local lesbian. The group's emotional stability crumbles entirely as Gretchen Rossi clashes with Tamra once again, and Vicki Gunvalson spirals into a vulnerable emotional tailspin amidst escalating marital discord.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Vicki Gunvalson struggles in the wake of her separation, finding herself completely isolated when her controversial new romance with Brooks Ayers alienates her daughter and longtime rivals Tamra Barney and Gretchen Rossi form a shocking new friendship. While Tamra focuses on her real estate career and Gretchen pursues entertainment opportunities in Las Vegas, ultra-polished former actress Heather Dubrow joins the neighborhood. Heather's sophisticated air immediately clashes with Alexis Bellino, culminating in relentless scrutiny that pushes their friendships to a breaking point during a tense getaway to Costa Rica.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: As Tamra Barney plans her wedding to Eddie, her joy is overshadowed by a fierce tug-of-war for her loyalty between Gretchen Rossi and Vicki Gunvalson, a rivalry exacerbated by the return of Lauri Peterson and her damaging rumors about Vicki. Hoping to land her dream home on a luxury magazine cover, Heather Dubrow introduces wealthy heiress Lydia McLaughlin to the group, though the spiritual newcomer quickly becomes overwhelmed playing peacekeeper during a high-stakes trip to Mexico. Meanwhile, professional jealousy erodes Gretchen and Heather’s mutual trust, leaving a cautious Alexis Bellino caught in the crossfire as she attempts to mend fences with the women who previously alienated her.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: As Heather Dubrow immerses herself in designing her sprawling mega-mansion, she introduces eccentric new neighbor Shannon Beador, whose hidden marital struggles and subsequent misunderstandings quickly ignite a bitter high-society feud between the two women. Meanwhile, Vicki Gunvalson faces a heartbreaking family crisis when the toxic animosity between her boyfriend and daughter forces Briana to move out of state. Into this emotional minefield steps opinionated former beauty queen Lizzie Rovsek, who fearlessly challenges the veteran housewives and triggers explosive confrontations during a dramatic group trip to Bali.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: As Heather Dubrow immerses herself in designing her sprawling mega-mansion, she introduces eccentric new neighbor Shannon Beador, whose hidden marital struggles and subsequent misunderstandings quickly ignite a bitter high-society feud between the two women. Meanwhile, Vicki Gunvalson faces a heartbreaking family crisis when the toxic animosity between her boyfriend and daughter forces Briana to move out of state. Into this emotional minefield steps opinionated former beauty queen Lizzie Rovsek, who fearlessly challenges the veteran housewives and triggers explosive confrontations during a dramatic group trip to Bali.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Isolated from her former friends, Vicki Gunvalson forms an intense bond with fearless newcomer Kelly Dodd, whose unfiltered, explosive energy sparks legendary screaming matches that completely disrupt the conservative enclave. Standing firm against Vicki, Tamra Judge juggles a new grandchild and her fitness empire while strengthening her bond with Shannon Beador, who enjoys a beautiful vow renewal despite lingering marital trauma. The group's fragile dynamic faces terrifying physical and emotional climaxes throughout the year, from a horrific high-speed sand dune crash in Glamis to a volatile overseas escape to Ireland organized by a newly pregnant Meghan King Edmonds.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: Any hope of peace in the OC is shattered when a vicious rumor campaign destroys Vicki Gunvalson and Tamra Judge’s former friendship, a conflict worsened when returning peacemaker Lydia McLaughlin inadvertently sparks a feud with an emotionally overwhelmed Shannon Beador. As Shannon endures agonizing personal stress and the slow-motion collapse of her marriage, Kelly Dodd faces a similarly painful marital crossroads but works hard to build bridges and show a softer side to her old rivals. Adding to the tension is wealthy newcomer Peggy Sulahian, whose private health battle and defensive nature draw the immediate suspicion of new mother Meghan King Edmonds, stoking deep mistrust just as the women embark on a volatile vacation to Iceland.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: The "Tres Amigas"—Vicki Gunvalson, Tamra Judge, and Shannon Beador—form an exclusive, tight-knit bond that creates a tough social barrier for newcomers Gina Kirschenheiter and Emily Simpson to navigate. As the new wives adjust to the group's intense dynamics, the veterans face major personal trials, with Shannon navigating life post-divorce and Tamra dealing with the immense emotional toll of her husband Eddie's serious heart condition. Meanwhile, a newly single Kelly Dodd injects a wild, unpredictable dating energy into the social scene that clashes with the older guard, ultimately culminating in a disastrous luxury trip to Jamaica where secret resentments shatter their delicate peace.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: Unconventional mother of seven Braunwyn Windham-Burke bursts onto the scene, bringing a free-spirited, partying energy that coincides with the explosive spread of malicious rumors regarding Kelly Dodd's sex life. Newly engaged Vicki Gunvalson helps propagate these scandalous whispers, creating a hostile war with Kelly that traps Tamra Judge in the middle, while a blissfully distracted Shannon Beador enjoys a beautiful personal rebirth and new romance. Amidst this escalating group tension, Gina Kirschenheiter faces a devastating domestic crisis and a DUI arrest, while Emily Simpson battles extreme marital loneliness, leading to a chaotic cast trip to Key West that leaves the women fractured.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: As a global pandemic forces the women behind their gated homes, eccentric newcomer Elizabeth Lyn Vargas joins the circle, sparking immediate suspicion over her opaque finances and unconventional romantic life. The year is defined by profound personal upheavals, notably Braunwyn Windham-Burke, who bravely confronts her alcoholism and makes shocking confessions about her identity that alienate her from a highly anxious, illness-stricken Shannon Storms Beador. Conversely, Gina Kirschenheiter and Emily Simpson find immense strength and renewal in their supportive friendship as they rebuild their lives and navigate a defiant Kelly Dodd, whose unfiltered opinions and whirlwind romance push the group's patience to the absolute limit.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: After a five-year hiatus, Heather Dubrow makes her return to the franchise joining veteran Housewives Shannon Storms Beador, Gina Kirschenheiter and Emily Simpson. The ladies are introduced to new Housewives Dr. Jen Armstrong and Noella Bergener.
